application_documents: Proof of ownership or allotment of the property (sale deed / allotment letter / GPA)
Photo ID of the applicant (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
Latest Delhi Jal Board water bill (consumer number)
Site photo of the roof and the proposed pit/tank location
Sketch of the rainwater harvesting system with dimensions (this summary can be attached)
Cancelled cheque or bank details for receiving financial assistance
For RWAs/societies: resolution authorising the applicant
